purpose.description: Your project successfully creates a visually appealing and responsive club website for the Brighton Art Club, fulfilling the main project goal.
You demonstrate responsive design concepts by using relative units (%, rem, em) and media queries to adjust layout and image sizes for different screen widths.
Consider adding more interactive or dynamic elements, such as a contact form or event calendar, to further enhance the club website's functionality.

readability.description: Your code is well-organized, with clear sectioning in both HTML and CSS, making it easy to follow and maintain.
Consider adding comments in your HTML to label major sections (e.g., <!-- About Section -->) for even easier navigation.
There is a small typo in your HTML meta tag: use 'name' instead of 'meta-name' for the viewport.

performance.description: You efficiently use CSS Flexbox and media queries to create a responsive layout that adapts well to different screen sizes.
To further optimize, consider using 'srcset' for images to serve appropriately sized images for different devices, improving load times.
For accessibility, consider adding more descriptive alt text to your images to better support screen readers.
